summary_note: Section 5.29. R and C are the same seed, initial model and data schedule on the PROBE-GUIDED adaptive arm with no forced operation, differing only in whether new experts are freshly drawn (R) or cloned from their layer's busiest survivor (C). The probe scores candidates with the default rebuild while the selected candidate is applied with the arm's flags, so once the two runs' weights differ the probe can re-rank and the runs can diverge - identical final genomes are RECORDED here, not asserted, and the primary is also reported on the agreeing subset. *_own are each run's own final genome retrained. Negative means the first-named run won.
